input: After user clarified all10000 capital is for investment, use frozen corrected25-feature labels for conservative3333 allocation (three simultaneous names),100-lot, both-side-fee, split/dividend-aware labels in validation/full-capital-optimization/dataset.json. The prior500-yuan research remains separate.
protocol: For yearY fit labels fully matured byY-2 Dec31. Platt-calibrate only prior-year signals whose labels/payments matured byY-1 Dec31. Freeze forY. No shuffled split, no early stopping, no threshold optimization. No changing10k/500/max3/minfee5 to make return targets pass.
signal: Trade only calibrated probability>=0.7 AND estimated net expectation>0, expectation uses positive/negative outcome means from the past calibration period, not later outcomes. Ranking by estimated net expectation. Probability is an experimental estimate, not an established70%chance.
tests: Brier score and log loss vs constant past calibration prior
threshold0.7 observed labels plus unresolved/maturity coverage
non-overlapping20-session cases, avoid calling overlapping daily labels independent
same fixed20-session/fees account backtest, all-cash no success
promotion: No model promotion from examined2023-2026 years alone. Need calibration, adequate effective sample, drawdown and net-return evidence plus new prospective validation. No claim of70%or10%-20%achievement.
limitations: Regime changes can break past calibration
Annual target belongs to total account, not merely invested positions
No large language model or paid service
